protocol.nolly: fit di_train (A), select on di_validation (V), read di_test (B), 48 kHz, SKIP 2400; share = RMS(d - q)/RMS(d) after SKIP, no floor
protocol.y_ref_fed: every variant reads y_ref: the frozen bound's r_ref is vacuous

prediction.written: 2026-10-11, in this script before its first reading of B. The scratch study (session scratchpad, run_b.json) had already read B for FIR 256 on y_ref on pairs 1->2, 1->4, 1->7, 39->30, 39->35, 39->36; the other pairs, the other variants, the reversed pairs and VS100R are unseen.
prediction.fragile_hypothesis: An output-referenced probe represents a change acting after the main clipping (tone knobs, cabinet) and fails for a gain change (before clipping).
prediction.metric: share = RMS(d_B - q_B) / RMS(d_B), selected variant (chosen on V)

classes.tone: one-knob B, M, T, P pairs and combinations with G unchanged
classes.gain: one-knob G pairs and combinations with G changed
classes.cab: cabinet on vs off, same amp settings: positive control
classes.repeat: same setting rendered twice: floor, not interpreted

rule.supported: median(gain) >= 0.6 and median(tone) <= 0.5 and median(gain) - median(tone) >= 0.15

prediction.secondary: Gain pairs: nonlinear y_ref features (yh5, ysat) gain more over yfir when the reference has the LOWER gain (re-clipping a less clipped output is possible, un-clipping is not). Supposed mechanism, measured by the reversed pairs.

vs100r.written: 2026-10-11, before any VS100R inference of this script, with demo/greybox_deep/evaluation_dry.json known: arm C needs its output delayed by about 1 sample (tau +0.95..+1.05; ln ESR -3.95 raw, -5.5 aligned, i.e. about 79 % of its error energy is that delay); GREY tau about -0.5 with ln ESR about -1.5 barely changed by alignment.

expected.C: the 1-sample advance is a filter of y_ref only in the causal direction: share(ref_device, yfir) - share(ref_device, yfir_lead16) >= 0.1, and share(ref_model, yfir) <= 0.6 on the seen-pair takes; the x probes leave more (H5 share >= share(ref_model, yfir) + 0.1)
expected.grey_boxes: GREY, L, F3 errors are mostly a wrong nonlinearity, not a filter of either output: share(ref_model, yfir) >= 0.6
expected.take_16: unseen gain-contour pair: the C error there is a wrong knob response, expected share(ref_model, yfir) higher than on the other takes

ysat.features: y_ref and tanh(a y_ref), a = 3, 10, 30, FIR 256

selection.rule: lowest median share on di_validation over the listed one-knob, combination and cab pairs (gate-4 pairs, reversed pairs, repeats excluded)

conditional.gain_ladder_note: gain 5 (take 20) has no one-knob pair from another setting: its only reference is a repeat (oracle, ref = same setting)

vs100r.protocol: fit di_validation, read di_test (VS100R, 48 kHz by resample_poly(., 1, 4) as in the evaluation path), SKIP 2400, CPU fp32

lag_V.definition: cross-correlation peak of y_model against y_device on di_validation, parabolic refinement, samples at 48 kHz, positive = model late
